source.doc: IBA Report 13-19, Review of the FY 2014 Proposed Budget (one-time resources used to balance; no structural figure stated)
IBA Report 13-19, Review of the FY 2014 Proposed Budget

note: Method: one-time resources used to balance the budget; the review states no one-time expenditure offset. 'The FY 2014 budget was balanced by using approximately $19.6 million (44%) in ongoing resources and $23.7 million (56%) in one-time resources' (p.1). Largest item: $21.6M one-time SDG&E settlement funds from the Public Liability Reserve (p.1); the remainder is not itemized, so components are null.

Not reported: IBA Report 14-15 (Review of the FY 2015 Proposed Budget, https://www.sandiego.gov/sites/default/files/14_15_140428.pdf) states no total. It says 'With negligible use of one-time resources and sound revenue assumptions, this proposed budget and its corresponding service levels are likely more sustainable than those proposed over the past eight years.' (p.1), and on p.7 gives a partial list: revenue increases since the Outlook 'include an increase of $5.4 million in one-time use of Transient Occupancy Tax fund balance, $2.2 million in Office of Homeland Security revenue reimbursements, and a $1.1 million increase in TransNet/gas tax funding, among a number of other revenue changes', and 'several non-recurring revenues are also incorporated into the FY 2015 Proposed Budget, as there are several non-recurring expenditures.' Only the $5.4M TOT item is labelled one-time; no total is printed.

Not reported: IBA Report 15-16 (Review of the FY 2016 Proposed Budget, https://www.sandiego.gov/sites/default/files/15_16_150427.pdf) states no amount of one-time resources used for ongoing costs and no structural deficit or balance statement for FY 2016.
Not reported: IBA Report 16-05 (Review of the FY 2017 Proposed Budget) states no amount of one-time resources used for ongoing costs and no structural deficit or balance statement for FY 2017.
